findingClass: an ipo_field_plan GAP row (cause stamped [gap-key:...]) is re-asked only when its field's gap key changes, so a gap nobody fixes waits indefinitely and is neither capped nor slot-stuck — invisible to pull_plan_config_gap_at_cap and pull_plan_stuck_reclaim (#884 review round 2 MINOR)
whatItAsks: no CHECK_FAILED gap-stamped plan row has last_attempt_at older than FIELD_PLAN_GAP_STALLED_DAYS (14) days (isStalledGapRow, scripts/lib/field-plan-slot.mjs)
healthy: 0 (WARN, not FAIL: the known gaps are the shrink-only baseline in manifest-rank-coverage-gaps.test.ts)
alarmsWhen: any non-zero, grouped by table.field with the IPO slugs each field holds (one notify per field)
scope: every IPO, every status and segment, prod + staging slots; state = CHECK_FAILED, cause gap-stamped
consumerReason: names the fields whose gap has had no manifest edit, adapter change, extractor bump or new document for two weekly cycles — the fix queue for coverage gaps
